rewrites.comment: The app uses client-side routing, so every path has to be served index.html. Without this, a shared link like /sorting?algo=quick&seed=2024 would 404 — the server has no such file.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints asset filenames, so they can be cached forever.
index.html must never be cached, or it keeps pointing at asset hashes from an old deploy.
